name: Holy Matcha
notes: Own site (holymatchasd.com, a small Wix page) publishes no menu or prices anywhere: homepage is an educational 'what is matcha' blurb, /shop explicitly says 'We don't have any products to show here right now', sitemap lists only home/shop/press. No ordering platform on the own site either (router agreed: no-platform). Found via web search that this DoorDash storefront exists; fetched directly with navigation headers, got 200, address confirmed 'University Ave, San Diego, CA 92104' matching this record. Read from the schema.org JSON-LD Menu block (doubly-nested hasMenuSection array, flattened). 16 priced items across 3 sections (Holy Menu, Holy Soft Serve, Holy Tea Menu) — a small cafe menu, plausibly the whole thing. Cent distribution: 8 on .00, 8 on .50 — clean. Divisor sweep at 1.04/1.10/1.15/1.20/1.25/1.30 found no consistent markup (best was 3/16 clean at 1.25). Note: a different 'Holy Matcha' Yelp listing (downtown, zip 92101) shows CLOSED — that is a separate, second location, not this North Park one at 3118 University Ave.

name: Mr. Moto Pizza Little Italy
notes: Restaurant's own Toast storefront (multi-location chain; this URL's Apollo-cache RestaurantLocation object confirms address 1702 India St, San Diego, CA 92101, matching this record — the generic /order landing page only carries location-picker metadata with no prices, the location-specific /order/<slug> path carries the full __OO_STATE__ catalog). 85 priced rows from 4 menus: Food (pizzas, salads, pasta, garlic knots, wings, desserts), Beverages, Catering, and a single Family Deal combo. Cent distribution: 49 on .00, 33 on .50, 2 on .99, 1 on .75 — clean, no markup pattern. Multi-size items (pizzas) carry a 'prices' array with no size label in the payload and an inconsistent internal ordering (verified against 'Half & Half', whose array order breaks the pattern the 15 Specialty Pies otherwise share) — so sizes were assigned Small/Medium/Large by sorting each item's own price array ascending, never by array position; this reassigns labels only, no price value was changed, invented, or divided. Dropped 'Sauce Side' (empty price array). Catering section included as priced (bulk order quantities, not per-diner adjunct).
